name: Taking Advantage
overview: Scripture clearly condemns taking advantage of others, especially those who are vulnerable such as strangers, hired servants, and the poor. God commands His people not to oppress or defraud their neighbors, emphasizing fairness and justice in dealings, as seen in the prohibition of false balances and withholding wages. Those who exploit the needy to increase their own wealth are warned of coming want, underscoring God’s delight in integrity and His protection of the afflicted within the community.
